annotations.title: Encontrar mais pessoas para a campanha

description: Finds NEW people for an existing campaign now and adds them to it ("add 40 more people to this campaign"), from the campaign's saved search or its signal, the same search its daily additions run. People already in the campaign are skipped; each person found goes into the cadence and the campaign's sheet. At most 200 per call; a campaign has no size limit. It spends credits, so it works in two calls: the first, with confirmed false, returns the price per person and the most it can cost and adds nobody; a call with confirmed true finds and adds the people. status no_audience means the campaign has neither a saved search nor a signal. When the campaign's signal has nothing new, the confirmed call runs the signal now and waits up to two minutes for it. When fewer people came in than asked, the result's note explains why, and funnel and funnelText count who was found and why the rest did not enter (same company, no channel, already in the campaign, outside the profile, the signal, the balance); people who did not enter are not charged. It only finds new people; it does not add people already in a sheet.

confirmed.description: false to get the price; true only after the user agreed to it.

count.description: How many new people to add.
